title: After 13 US midterms gold dipped and then rose 10% from the low in 7 — exactly as often as from the same November week in other years; the saying is gold's November-to-spring seasonality, not the election
strategy: none — a market saying about gold after US midterm elections
question: After a US midterm election, does gold dip and then rise about 100 dollars more often, or by more, than at other times?
hypothesis: Gold dips after the midterm vote and then rallies about 100 dollars, more than in ordinary weeks.

findings.title: The dip is small
findings.detail: 11 of 13 midterms closed lower at some point in the first 8 weeks; the median low was −1.85%. From any week since 1974 the median low over 8 weeks is −2.16%, so the first dip is ordinary.
findings.detail_zh: 13 次裡 11 次在選後 8 週內先跌，跌幅中位數 −1.85%。隨便哪一週起算，8 週內最低點的中位數是 −2.16%，所以「先跌」是常態，不是選舉造成的。

findings.title: Dip then +10%: 54%, the same as other Novembers
findings.detail: 7 of 13 midterms (54%) dipped and then rose 10% from the low within 26 weeks. The same November week in the 26 non-election years did so in 54% as well; any week did so in 37% (difference 17 points, bound 38).
findings.title_zh: 先跌再漲 10%：54%，和其他年的 11 月一樣
findings.detail_zh: 13 次裡 7 次（54%）先跌、再從低點漲 10% 以上。26 個非選舉年的同一週也是 54%；隨便哪一週是 37%（差 17 個百分點，樣本要差 38 個百分點才分得出來）。

findings.title: Half-year return inside noise
findings.detail: Mean return 26 weeks after the midterm 6.17% against 5.49% for the same week in other years and 4.16% for any week; the bound for 13 events is 11.7 points.
findings.title_zh: 選後半年報酬在雜訊內
findings.detail_zh: 選後 26 週平均 +6.17%；其他年同一週 +5.49%，隨便一週 +4.16%。13 次的樣本要差 11.7 個百分點才分得出來。

findings.title: 100 dollars is a price-level effect
findings.detail: Every midterm from 2010 rose more than 100 dollars from its low, because gold was above 1,100; before 2010 only 1982 did. At today's price 100 dollars is 2.4%, which 67% of all weeks reach after a dip.
findings.title_zh: 100 美金是金價水位造成的
findings.detail_zh: 2010 年以後每次都從低點漲超過 100 美金，因為金價已在 1,100 以上；2010 年以前只有 1982 年做到。以現在約 4,168 的價格，100 美金只有 2.4%，隨便一週先跌後有 67% 會漲到。

findings.title: Presidential elections: no better, if anything weaker
findings.detail: After 13 presidential elections the 26-week mean was −0.69% and dip-then-+10% happened in 15%; neither difference is resolvable.
findings.title_zh: 總統大選後也沒有比較好
findings.detail_zh: 13 次總統大選後 26 週平均 −0.69%，先跌再漲 10% 只有 15%；兩者都在雜訊內。

card_summary: On 13 US midterms 1974–2022, gold dipped and then rose 10% from the low in 54% — the same rate as the same November week in 26 non-election years, and inside noise against any week. The '100 dollars' holds since 2010 only because gold's price level made 100 dollars small.
title_zh: 美國期中選舉後黃金「先跌再漲」：13 次裡 7 次，和其他年的 11 月一樣多；這是黃金 11 月到隔年春天的季節性，不是選舉效應
question_zh: 美國期中選舉後，黃金是否比平常更常先跌、再漲 100 美金左右？
hypothesis_zh: 期中選舉投票後黃金先跌，接著上漲約 100 美金，幅度或頻率高於一般時候。
card_summary_zh: 1974–2022 年 13 次期中選舉，選後先跌再從低點漲 10% 的比例是 54%，和 26 個非選舉年同一週完全一樣，和隨便哪一週比也在雜訊內。2010 年後每次都漲超過 100 美金，是因為金價變高，100 美金變得很小。
limitations_zh: 只有 13 次期中選舉，每個比較都遠在可分辨範圍內。
用週收盤；2008 年以前看不到週內的低點。
設計前已在對話中快速看過一次結果（決策紀錄已揭露）。
每個觀察期都包含 12 月 FOMC，無法分開它的影響。
interpretation_zh: 這個說法描述的走勢是真的，但原因不是選舉：每年 11 月起算的半年，黃金本來就常先小跌再上漲，期中選舉年和其他年一樣。「100 美金」只在金價高的年代成立。今年的投票日是 11/3（台北 11/4），不能當進出場依據。
